Validate Data Quality Using Rule-Based Framework

validate_data.Rd

Validates data against a set of predefined rules. Returns either a summary report or the full validation object.

Usage

validate_data(data, input_rules, output_format = c("report", "object"))

Arguments

data

A data.frame or data.table.

input_rules

A set of rules, defined in a dataframe.

output_format

A string specifying the output format: "report" for a summary report or "object" for the raw validation results.

Value

A data.frame containing the audit report with columns:

Rule

Short label for the rule (from input_rules$label)

Description

Detailed explanation of what the rule checks

Total Records

Number of records evaluated

Passes

Number of records that passed the rule

Pass Rate

Percentage of records passing (0-100)

Fails

Number of records that failed the rule

Errors

Logical indicating whether the rule threw an error

Details

Validate Data Against Quality Rules

The function validates data against user-defined rules using the validate package.

See also

personnel_rules for personnel validation rules contract_rules for contract validation rules

Examples

# Validate contract data
audit_report <- validate_data(
  data = govhr::bra_hrmis_contract,
  input_rules = govhr::contract_rules
)

# View the audit report
print(audit_report)
